parameters.content:
## 10 Comment To DM Bridge

Keyword comment to a DM with the asset, with the comment stored as the consent record.

**Safety rails:** Calls 16-safety-rails before any outbound action.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: Comment Webhook
nodes.notes: Meta/TikTok comment webhook. Needs an approved app - see Limitations in README.

nodes.name: Ignore Comment
nodes.notes: No keyword, no DM. Unsolicited DMs are how accounts get restricted.

nodes.name: Safety Rails
nodes.notes: Calls 16-safety-rails. Nothing that can reach a prospect runs before the rails return allowed=true.

nodes.name: Rails Allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch is a dead end by design.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ handle: $json.lead.handle, text: ($env.ASSET_DM_TEXT || 'Here is the link you asked for:') + ' ' + $env.ASSET_URL, reply_to_comment: $json.lead.post_id }) }}

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO consent_ledger (lead_id, identifier, identifier_type, basis, evidence, source, recorded_at)
VALUES (NULL, '{{ $json.lead.handle }}', 'handle', 'consent',
        jsonb_build_object('comment', '{{ $json.lead.last_inbound_message }}',
                           'post_id', '{{ $json.lead.post_id }}',
                           'keyword', '{{ $json.keyword }}'),
        '10-comment-to-dm-bridge', NOW());

nodes.name: Log Consent
nodes.notes: This row is the evidence that the contact asked you to DM them. Keep it.

nodes.name: CRM Upsert
nodes.notes: One HTTP node, one mapping node. Swap CRM by changing CRM_BASE_URL, the credential and CRM_ADAPTER. See docs/CRM-MAPPING.md.
